name: std::future_status
intro: Specifies state of a future as returned by wait_for and wait_until functions of std::future and std::shared_future.

sections.title: Constants
sections.text:
Name

 Explanation




 deferred

 the shared state contains a deferred function, so the result will be computed only when explicitly requested




 ready

 the shared state is ready




 timeout

 the shared state did not become ready before specified timeout duration has passed
